proof:
intro N inst hN
  classical
  have hd (a b : ℕ) (ha : a < N) (hb : b < N) (hab : a ≠ b) :
      (a : ZMod N) ≠ (b : ZMod N) := by
    intro he
    apply hab
    have hv := congrArg (fun x : ZMod N => x.val) he
    simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] using hv
  have h01 : (0 : ZMod N) ≠ 1 := hd 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h02 : (0 : ZMod N) ≠ 2 := hd 0 2 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h03 : (0 : ZMod N) ≠ 3 := hd 0 3 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h12 : (1 : ZMod N) ≠ 2 := hd 1 2 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h13 : (1 : ZMod N) ≠ 3 := hd 1 3 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h23 : (2 : ZMod N) ≠ 3 := hd 2 3 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  simp [M8.P4Family.support, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23]
